source_read: https://www.greeneking.co.uk/allergens (page data), https://www.greeneking.co.uk/pubs/west-yorkshire/new-inn/menu and /allergens (a Pub & Social pub), https://www.greeneking.co.uk/robots.txt, https://www.smartchef.co.uk/robots.txt, https://gkbr-p-001.sitecorecontenthub.cloud/robots.txt (allows /api/public/), the Pub & Social Core Menu Nutritional Information PDF (text and page images), the 'Non-Gluten Containing Menu - Nutritional Information' PDF and the Lunch Menu PDF (all read 2026-10-08)
not_verifiable: Greene King's per-dish allergen data is only on Smart Chef: each pub page's 'View Allergen Info' button goes to https://www.smartchef.co.uk/brands/<brand>?siteid=<pub id> (the New Inn, Leeds, a Pub & Social pub: https://www.smartchef.co.uk/brands/LocalsValue?siteid=7873). https://www.smartchef.co.uk/robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /', so nothing was fetched from it. The chain's own allergens page (https://www.greeneking.co.uk/allergens) offers only a pub finder; its 'Download our Allergen Menu' component has an empty menu list. The published source, the Pub & Social Core Menu Nutritional Information PDF (Spring Summer 2024, Version 1, 16 pages), has columns for energy, fat, saturates, carbohydrate, sugars, protein and salt and no allergen text or icons. The 'Non-Gluten Containing Menu - Nutritional Information' PDF (5 pages, May 2024) is the same table for the no-gluten-containing dishes only (gluten status of those dishes, not the 14 allergens). The Lunch Menu PDF (March 2026) prints no allergens and says 'we do not include may contain information' and that allergen information is in the app / on the website.
